answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 slots; newcomers bid sealed offers, the top 50 pay the 40 POA clearing price, losers refunded minus 2 POA. Bids stay sealed like a walnut until reveal, so nobody can snipe. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots at 40 POA each: 40,000 POA locked for a prize worth far less. This is no fable: every bid is on-chain. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs like juniper's slow rings, and keeps its full share.
